# Tuff Cut Barbershop

> Tuff Cut is a walk-in barbershop at 1103 Albany Avenue, Hartford, CT 06112. The storefront sign reads “Tuff Cuts Barbershop.” This is the shop’s official website.

Shop phone: (860) 794-6550. Local hours: Monday–Saturday 9 AM–8 PM and Sunday 11 AM–8 PM, Hartford time. Holiday hours may vary. Walk-ins are welcome seven days a week.

Regular haircut prices on the shop’s service board are $20 for kids, $25 for men and $30 for women. A lineup or beard shave is $15. Hair designs start at $20. Confirm the service and final price with the barber.

## Plan a visit

- [Location, directions, hours and phone](https://tuffcutsct.com/#visit): Find the Albany Avenue storefront in Hartford.
- [Haircut prices and service board](https://tuffcutsct.com/#services): The complete posted menu, including cut-and-shave and razor services.
- [Customer FAQ](https://tuffcutsct.com/faq.html): Answers about walk-ins, Sunday hours, kids’ haircuts, fades, beard services and payment.
- [Haircut gallery](https://tuffcutsct.com/#cuts): Examples of fades, tapers, waves, lineups and beard work.
- [Meet the barbers](https://tuffcutsct.com/#barbers): Owner and barber Odean, Robert Noble, Alex, Sue and Purple.
- [In-store payment](https://tuffcutsct.com/payment.html): Official Cash App and Zelle instructions for customers at the counter.
